text: {"name":"bt_h4_packet_length","confidence":"high","docstring":"Returns the total H:4 frame length from its packet indicator and type-specific payload length field, or -1 for an unsupported packet type.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"a1":"h4_packet","v1":"packet_type"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"H:4 packet indicator (1=command, 2=ACL, 3=SCO, 4=event)"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"HCI event parameter length when the packet indicator is 4"},{"offset":3,"meaning":"HCI command or SCO payload length; for ACL packets, the little-endian 16-bit payload length"}]}
